name: zsnd_sample_play_on_active_backend
description: zSndSample::PlayOnActiveBackend dispatches sample playback to DirectSound or A3D according to the active backend.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage covers backend 0 and backend 1 dispatch; unsupported-backend behavior remains covered by source review of the fall-through null return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49fa10 dispatches backend 0 through zSnd::GainScaleToDirectSoundAttenuation and zSndSample::PlayOnDirectSound, backend 1 through zSndSample::PlayOnA3D, and returns null for unsupported backend ids.
The native smokes verify backend 0 and backend 1 dispatch through zSndSample::PlayA3D with both no-position and world-position playback.
